purpose: Extend the ACIS 21500 third-header-word screen to the locally available AC1024 sample drawings without transferring semantics across versions.

method.selection: Local /Users/dli/doc/dwg top-level DWGs with AC1024 signatures; enumerate 3DSOLID, BODY, REGION and SURFACE objects with ACIS BinaryFile payloads; decode the first four little-endian 32-bit words after the 15-byte magic.

aggregate.producerProvenance: Not independently authenticated for these exact AC1024 samples
aggregate.otherAc1024Drawings: Five valid minJSON exports contained no selected ACIS payloads. The minJSON output for visualization_-_condominium_with_skylight.dwg was invalid JSON despite dwgread exit status 0 and is excluded.

conclusion: This expands repetition of one header profile, not discriminating evidence. The third word remains raw and semantically unresolved for ACIS 21500; do not infer body count or a first-owned-record boundary from these values.
nextEvidence: A version-qualified ACIS 21.5 producer/schema witness or a discriminating multi-root payload with independently established root-record semantics.
claimEffect: No parser semantic, output eligibility, B-rep, native-consumer or support claim is promoted.
